milestone.title: Wireshark release 4.0
milestone.description:
Issues and merge requests for the 4.0.0 release, which is currently unscheduled. Major changes include:

* Dropping support for 32-bit Windows.
* Shipping our Windows and macOS packages with Qt 6.
* Display filter syntax fixes and enhancements.
* Conversation UI updates.
* Various build requirement updates.

commits_data.title: Qt: Make TrafficTable detachable
commits_data.message:
Qt: Make TrafficTable detachable

Allow the endpoint and conversation dialogs to have detachable
tabs. At the same time move the tree functionality to a subclass
to better be able to handle the context menu when detached.

Right now, still a lot of tree stuff is in the tabwidget, but
could be moved to the tree for the future
